title: Brazilian Biryani-Style Veggies
description: A keto-friendly twist on the Indian classic, featuring juicy vegetables and a pungent kick.

ingredients.name: Brazilian vegetables (such as collard greens and cabbage)
Biryani rice mix (make sure it's keto-friendly)

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add Brazilian vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in biryani rice mix, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
